requirements.title: CPU_TIME assigns an unavailable-time sentinel or processor-time approximation
requirements.definition: If meaningful time cannot be provided, TIME is assigned a processor-dependent negative value; otherwise TIME is assigned a processor-dependent approximation to processor time in seconds.

pending.cpu-time-unavailable-assigns-negative: No portable exact value oracle exists for the unavailable-time branch because the negative value is processor dependent and a conforming processor might or might not take this branch.
pending.cpu-time-available-assigns-processor-tim: No portable exact value oracle exists for the available-time branch because the approximation, resolution, start point, and rounding are processor dependent.
